submissiondate.title: Submitted
submissiondate.remarks: The date when the certification was submitted to the regulatory agency or authority.

wellpad.title: Well Pad
wellpad.remarks: The surface area within which oil wells or gas wells are situated.

county.title: County
county.remarks: The county in which the oil field or the gas reservoir is located.

expiredate.title: Expiry
expiredate.remarks: The date when the certification expires.

ownergroup.title: Owner Group
ownergroup.remarks: The group that owns the certification record. To change this value, use the Select Action > Select Owner option.

leasename.title: Lease Name
leasename.remarks: The name of the lease under which the oil field or the gas reservoir is registered.

regulationnum.title: Regulation
regulationnum.remarks: The regulation that is associated with the certification record.

siteid.title: Site
siteid.remarks: The site that is associated with the certification record.

details.title: Details
details.remarks: The details of the certification record.

state.title: State
state.remarks: The state in which the oil field or the gas reservoir is located.

awardedby.title: Awarded To
awardedby.remarks: The person who received the certification.

issueddate.title: Issued
issueddate.remarks: The date of issue of the certification.

externalapprdate.title: External Approval
externalapprdate.remarks: The date when the certification was approved by the external organization that issued the certificate.

wellname.title: Well Name
wellname.remarks: The name of the well within a geographic area or field.

externalref.title: External Reference
externalref.remarks: The identifier that was assigned to the certification by the external organization that issued the certification.

orgid.title: Organization
orgid.remarks: The organization that is associated with the certification record.

plusgregpertype.title: Regulatory Permit Type
plusgregpertype.remarks: The type of regulatory permit. Valid values are in the PLUSGREGPERTYPE domain.

issueagency.title: Issuing Agency
issueagency.remarks: The external organization, such as a regulatory agency, that issued the certification.

plusgprocedureid.title: Operating Procedure
plusgprocedureid.remarks: The operating procedure that is associated with the certification record.

plusgactionsumm.title: Review Action Summary
plusgactionsumm.remarks: A summary of the review actions that are associated with the certification.

fincntrlid.title: Project Unique Identifier
fincntrlid.remarks: The project identifier that is associated with the certification.

plusgauditid.title: Audit
plusgauditid.remarks: The Audit and Survey application record that is associated with the certification.

certnum.title: Certification
certnum.remarks: The identifier of the certification record.

status.title: Status
status.remarks: The status of the certification record. Valid statuses are in the PLUSGCERTSTATUS synonym domain. The default value when you create the certification record is Draft. Use the Change Status icon on the toolbar to modify the status of the certification record.

template.title: Template
template.remarks: Indicates that the record can be used as a template to create other certification records. Only certain fields and their values are duplicated. Duplicate fields and their values are copied from the originating record to the new record.

pertypenum.title: Permit and Certificate Type
pertypenum.remarks: The type of permit or certificate that is associated with the certification record. The status of the type of permit or certificate must be active. You can either select a value or create a type of permit or certificate record using the Permit and Certificate Types application.

description.title: Description
description.remarks: A description of the certification record.

effectivedate.title: Effective
effectivedate.remarks: The date when the certification became effective.

itemid.title: Item
itemid.remarks: The item that is associated with the certification.

plusgtotalscore.title: Total Score
plusgtotalscore.remarks: The total score that is assigned to the review actions that are associated with the certification.

assetnum.title: Asset
assetnum.remarks: The asset that is associated with the certification  record.

apinumber.title: API Number
apinumber.remarks: The identifier that is assigned to each oil well or to each gas reservoir.

owner.title: Owner
owner.remarks: The owner of the certification record. You use the Select Action > Select Owner option to assign either a person or a person group to own the certification record. To take ownership of the certification process, use the Select Action > Take Ownership option.

classstructureid.title: Class Structure
classstructureid.remarks: The identifier of the classification structure.

issuedby.title: Issued By
issuedby.remarks: The person who issued the certification.

extnum.title: Extension
extnum.remarks: The number of the extension for the certification. A certification can be in any status, except Inactive status, for its duration to be extended. When you extend a certification, the certification expiry date is extended until the date that you specify in the Extend Expiry Until field. An extension number is generated. The extension number starts with 0 and increments by 1 for each subsequent extension.

statusdate.title: Status Date
statusdate.remarks: The server date and time when the certification record was created, or when the status changed of the certification record. This value is read-only.

fieldname.title: Field Name
fieldname.remarks: The name of the geographic area that contains an oil well or a gas well.

location.title: Location
location.remarks: The location that is associated with the certification record.

regpermit.title: Regulatory Permit
regpermit.remarks: Indicates whether the certification is a regulatory permit.

category.title: Category
category.remarks: The category of the certification record.

externalstatus.title: External Status
externalstatus.remarks: The status that was assigned to the certification by the issuing organization. Valid values are in the PLUSGCERTEXTSTAT domain.

procnum.title: Operating Procedure
procnum.remarks: The operating procedure that is associated with the certification record.
